title: ✈️ sarnia — Jul 19, 2026
itinerary_text:
## 🚗 ROAD TRIP OVERVIEW

*   **Route:** Brampton → Windsor (2-hour stop) → Sarnia
*   **Total Driving Distance:** Approx. 460 km (Brampton to Windsor: 360km; Windsor to Sarnia: 100km).
*   **Estimated Driving Time:** Total driving time is approximately 4 hours and 45 minutes of pure road time (excluding stops).
*   **Rest Stop Recommendation:** Your requested stop in Windsor serves as the perfect mid-point rest stop after the 3.5-hour drive from Brampton.
*   **Logistics:** Leaving Brampton by 9:00 AM ensures you arrive in Windsor by 12:30 PM. After your 2-hour visit, you will depart by 2:30 PM, arriving in Sarnia by 4:00 PM (well before your 7:00 PM deadline).

---

## Day 1 – Sunday, July 19: The Journey & Arrival
*   **Morning:** Depart Brampton. Drive to Windsor.
*   **Mid-Day (Windsor Stop):** Meet your contact. Grab lunch for 4 at **Walkerville Brewery** (great casual atmosphere, fits groups easily).
*   **Afternoon:** Drive from Windsor to Sarnia (approx. 1 hour 30 mins).
*   **Evening:** Check into the hotel. Dinner at **Ups N' Downs** in downtown Sarnia—a classic pub with space for 4, perfect for a relaxed start to the trip.

## Day 2 – Monday, July 20: Adventure & Relaxation
*   **Morning:** Head to **Canatara Park**. It is a massive beachfront park. Rent a kayak or paddleboard (Adventure) or lounge on the sandy shores of Lake Huron (Relaxation).
*   **Afternoon:** Head to **Lambton Mall** for some shopping. 
*   **Evening:** Dinner at **Tin Fiddler** (Downtown Sarnia). Excellent for groups; great food and live music vibes.

## Day 3 – Tuesday, July 21: Waterfront & Departure
*   **Morning:** Visit **Centennial Park** along the St. Clair River. Walk the waterfront trail—a great group activity for photos.
*   **Lunch:** **Alternate Grounds Dockside**. Located right on the water, this spot has ample seating for 4 and offers a beautiful view to end the trip.
*   **Afternoon:** Depart Sarnia for the drive back to Brampton.

---

## 🏨 Hotel Recommendations
*Prices are estimated for 2 nights for 4 people sharing one room.*

1.  **Best Western Plus Guildwood Inn:** Features rooms with two Queen beds. Very group-friendly and budget-conscious.
2.  **Holiday Inn Express Sarnia:** Offers rooms with two Queen beds + a pull-out sofa option. Includes free breakfast (saves money!).

---

## 📊 TRIP SUMMARY (Per Person & Group)

*Note: Economy budget assumes shared accommodation and mid-range dining.*

| Item | Per Person Cost | Total Group Cost (4 people) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gas (Est. Round trip + local)** | $40 | $160 |
| **Hotel (2 nights, shared room)** | $160 | $640 |
| **Food & Drink ($60/day)** | $180 | $720 |
| **Activities (Rentals/Misc)** | $50 | $200 |
| **TOTAL** | **$430** | **$1,720** |

**Budget Notes:**
*   **Gas:** Based on current average fuel prices and vehicle consumption for the ~600km round trip + local driving.
*   **Hotel:** Estimated at ~$160/night total for a standard room with two queen beds.
*   **Food:** Estimated at $60 per person, per day, for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
*   **Activities:** Covers kayak/board rentals and small shopping splurges.

---

**AI Travel Tip:** Since you are traveling as a group of 4, always call ahead for dinner reservations at the suggested restaurants, especially for Monday/Tuesday evenings, to ensure your group is seated together promptly!
